content = file_content['content']
songs_to_archive = []

        # Remove the leading "- "
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artist
        if ' by ' in song_str:

            songs_to_archive.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artist': artist.strip()})
